I know the standard lubricant is out of stock, but there are 30 liters of an alternate lubricant available in the maintenance storeroom. As the one who authorizes emergency maintenance-material purchases and associated operating controls, I need to understand the full picture before I can sign off. Normally, we'd review any substitution with maintenance, quality, and EHS before authorization. Can someone walk me through the specifics of this alternate lubricant and whether it's suitable for the gearbox?
